items.description: A currency, matched by ItemId, then by its code.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the currency. When it matches a stored currency, that currency is updated. Otherwise a new currency is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: The three-letter ISO-4217 currency code in upper case, for example USD. A currency without a matching ItemId is matched by this code.

DisplayName.description: The friendly name shown in currency dropdowns, for example US Dollar.

Currencies.description: The currencies to create or update.
